title: Axiom Server IR v8
description: The normative structure of an `axiom.server.v8` document. Structure only: what a conforming runtime must *do* with it is the semantic contract, and the conformance fixtures are the executable statement of that.

LiteralValue.description: Portable data. No undefined, NaN, Infinity, date object or class instance.

Expression.description: Every expression kind: literal, ref, field, object, binary, unary, call, filter, find, map, sort, every, some, flatten, conditional, group, expression-ref.

Operation.description: Every operation kind: set, insert, remove, for-each, invoke, navigate, native, integration-query, integration-effect, blob-metadata, blob-commit, blob-delete, query.

source.description: A semantic source name the adapter maps to a topic, URL, queue or device. Never a broker address, a socket or a path.

MigrationOperation.description: The closed migration operation vocabulary: add-entity, remove-entity, add-field, remove-field, change-field, populate-field, transform-field, transform-record, add-relationship, remove-relationship.
